questions.stem_text: With respect to the kinked demand curve, which of the following is NOT correct?

options.B: There are relatively equal shares of the market.
options.C: Price is greater than marginal costs.
options.D: The demand curve is of one continuous function.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - The demand curve is of one continuous function.

questions.stem_text: Is the achievement of full employment sufficient for the maintenance of growth?

options.A: Growth only depends on full employment
options.C: Full employment always leads to increasing per capita output
options.D: No, full employment is not sufficient for the maintenance of growth

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - No, full employment is not sufficient for the maintenance of growth

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is true about a price floor?

options.A: It will be located in the middle of the equilibrium price.
options.B: It will be located below the equilibrium price.
options.C: It will be located above the equilibrium price.
options.D: It will be located above the market price.
options.E: It is used when the equilibrium price is too high.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - It will be located above the equilibrium price.

questions.stem_text: When the price of pears increases, we expect the following:

options.C: There is no change in the quantity demanded or supplied.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - Quantity demanded of pears falls.
